items: Switch off output diesel circuit breaker
Switch off input distribution board 380 v
Wear your safety helmet, gloves, goggles, shoes
Check fan hub drive pulley and water pump
Check air cleaner restriction piping and connection
Check exhaust system for exhaust restriction
Check battery charging system input and output voltage
Check battery electrolyte level and specific gravity
Check engine for unusual vibration also noise and heating
Clean the main generator air inlet and outlet for restriction
Clean the generator and check the switch gear start in automatic
Clean the diesel engines using blower
Remove any remaining oil and grease using solvent
Perform operational loud test for the engine
